name: Ken Blackburn
occupation: Former Big Horn County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election; the Lovell Chronicle described him as recently retired when Jason Beal was appointed interim sheriff in April 2026)
prior_offices: Big Horn County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election)
background: Ken Blackburn served as Big Horn County sheriff after winning the November 2022 general election. The Lovell Chronicle reported on April 9, 2026, that commissioners appointed Jason Beal as interim sheriff and that Beal had been the lead deputy for courtroom security under recently retired sheriff Ken Blackburn.
